sentences.en: It is morning.
Mina wakes up in her bed and looks for Nino.
sentences.fa: مینا در تختش بیدار می‌شود و دنبال نینو می‌گردد.

sentences.en: She wakes, and the baby wakes.
sentences.fa: او بیدار می‌شود، و نوزاد هم بیدار می‌شود.

sentences.en: Nino is not in her bed.
Mina is in her bedroom.
Her small bedroom feels empty without Nino.
sentences.fa: اتاق‌خواب کوچک او بدون نینو خالی به نظر می‌رسد.

sentences.en: Mina goes to the bathroom.
The toilet is in the bathroom.
Her brother goes to the toilet.
Dad is in the shower.
He washes in the shower.
Mom washes the baby while Mina washes too.
sentences.fa: مامان نوزاد را می‌شوید و مینا هم خودش را می‌شوید.

sentences.en: Mina has a bath.
She has a bath every morning.
Mom is in the kitchen.
"Come to the kitchen, Mina!" Mom says.
"Eat your breakfast," Mom says gently.
Mina looks at her breakfast.
Breakfast is bread and an egg.
sentences.fa: صبحانه نان و یک تخم‌مرغ است.

sentences.en: Mina looks at her breakfast but does not eat.
sentences.fa: مینا به صبحانه‌اش نگاه می‌کند، اما چیزی نمی‌خورد.

sentences.en: "Eat your egg, and I will drink my milk," Mom says.
sentences.fa: «تو تخم‌مرغت را بخور و من شیرم را می‌نوشم»، مامان می‌گوید.

sentences.en: "Eat your egg," Dad says again.
Mina drinks her milk.
The baby drinks water.
Dad drinks water.
Her brother eats his bread.
"Nino eats my bread," her brother says.
sentences.fa: «نینو نان من را می‌خورد»، برادرش می‌گوید.

sentences.en: "And Nino drinks my milk," he says.
sentences.fa: «و نینو شیر من را هم می‌نوشد»، او می‌گوید.

sentences.en: Mina eats with her brother.
She drinks milk with her bread.
Now Nino is not at home.
"Where is he now?" Mina says quietly.
"Today we look for Nino together," Dad says.
sentences.fa: «امروز همه با هم دنبال نینو می‌گردیم»، بابا می‌گوید.

sentences.en: "Today and every day," Mom says.
"Every day," Mina says. "Every day."
"We look all day," Dad says.
"All day," Mina says, and she keeps looking.
sentences.fa: «تمام روز»، مینا می‌گوید و به جست‌وجو ادامه می‌دهد.

sentences.en: Mina goes upstairs.
She looks in the rooms upstairs.
sentences.fa: او به اتاق‌های طبقه‌ی بالا نگاه می‌کند.

sentences.en: "You look upstairs, and I look downstairs," Dad says.
sentences.fa: «تو طبقه‌ی بالا را نگاه کن و من طبقه‌ی پایین را»، بابا می‌گوید.

sentences.en: Her brother goes downstairs.
He looks in the rooms downstairs.
sentences.fa: او به اتاق‌های طبقه‌ی پایین نگاه می‌کند.

sentences.en: Mina looks at the walls.
The walls in her room are red.
She looks at the floor.
Nino is not on the floor.
Come home today, Nino.
Come home now.

check.q: مینا برای صبحانه نان و چه چیزی دارد؟
مینا و خانواده‌اش چه زمانی دنبال نینو می‌گردند؟
